name: Better Recipe Book: Rebetterered
implementation_base: original BRB; Extended API/behavior reference only

validation.public_delivery_checks: Performed after upload; packaged evidence covers the tested candidate
validation.packaged_multiplayer_bulk: Learned and undiscovered 68-batch scenarios: exactly two result QUICK_MOVE and zero result PICKUP with authoritative conservation
validation.backpack_native_bulk: Repeated 68-batch cycles: exactly two result QUICK_MOVE and zero result PICKUP; output in bag and holder component consistent
validation.backpack_polymer_bulk: Repeated 68-batch cycles: exactly two result QUICK_MOVE and zero result PICKUP; output in bag and holder component consistent

changes.native_crafting_pins: Exact variant tab with native grid selection, search and craftable filtering
changes.craft_all_method_optional: FILL_GRID; actual result QUICK_MOVE for supported crafting, remainders, smithing and known backpack storage groups, with complete confirmed snapshots before refill
changes.overflow_transfer: Bulk result THROW when storage is full and dropping is allowed; one result PICKUP at the first-dropping-batch edge for STOP_AFTER_DROP
changes.bulk_guarded_cases: Conservative stop for unequal consumed ingredient counts, optional unused smithing inputs, unsupported reusable/multi-count remainders, untracked offhand merges, ambiguous identical backpacks and partial-capacity loads that would spill under STOP_BEFORE_DROP; no silent per-batch fallback
changes.backpack_holder_sync: Apply output-addition callbacks so backpack holder components match authoritative bag contents across repeated crafts; remainders retain vanilla player/grid handling
changes.untracked_offhand_guard: Conservative refusal applies to bulk and single-batch overflow planning; switching to SINGLE_BATCHES does not bypass unobservable remainder merges
